About this home

26 E 1860 N is a fully renovated two-story in the Overlake area of north Tooele — move-in ready. The kitchen is all new: shaker cabinets, stone countertops, a tile backsplash, and stainless appliances, opening to a bright dining and living area with new luxury vinyl plank flooring and a waterfall-edge island.

New carpet in the bedrooms, refreshed baths with new tiled showers, and a clean single-tone white interior throughout. Major updates include a brand-new roof and a new garage door. Outside, there's new sod front, side, and back with a working sprinkler system and a fully fenced backyard.

The owner is a licensed Utah real estate agent. Listing information deemed reliable but not guaranteed; buyer to verify all figures.
